blocks.text: Nxled beat Creamline in four sets, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, to secure the first twice-to-beat advantage in the semifinals of the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference on Tuesday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
